say:0:1522007001:0.text: The ingredients are quite common; we can easily find them around here.
say:0:1522007001:0.source_cn: 蜂蜜、甲刺棕椰、卷蕨草都很常见，附近就有。
say:0:1522007001:0.male: The ingredients are quite common; we can easily find them around here.
say:0:1522007001:0.female: The ingredients are quite common; we can easily find them around here.

say:1:1522007002:0.text: We should gather some honey too, just in case.
say:1:1522007002:0.source_cn: 虽然他们也去找蜂蜜了，但以防万一，我们也准备一些吧。
say:1:1522007002:0.male: We should gather some honey too, just in case.
say:1:1522007002:0.female: We should gather some honey too, just in case.
